description: Dark and gray brushstrokes run horizontally across a light surface. The composition looks like an open landscape made of lines.
A small seated figure with a blue cloak sits before a bed. Light body form and dark cloak lie centrally in the image.
Three face-like forms stand before a blue background. A light central form is framed by two orange forms.
A wide landscape with light and dark bands fills the image. Sky, water, and ground are loosely separated.
Three narrow light fields stand on a dark ground. A small red form lies at the lower left, while the right half remains almost empty.
A seated woman leans sideways against a wall. Her dark top, pink skirt, and chair are clearly separated.
A colorful body-like figure stands on a yellow-brown ground. Blue, red, gray, and black form large clearly separated areas.
Colorful snail-like forms lie on a dark ground and curl into one another. The large color areas are clearly separated.
A black circle lies low and touches a light silhouette. The ground is dark, and the two forms are barely separated.
A dark ruin lies flat in the foreground under a light sky. Clouds and small rider are almost absent, and spatial depth is weak.
